title: Cantor Fitzgerald&\#x27;s Nvidia stake cut draws scrutiny amid Lutnick spy-case questions
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald reported a nearly 50% decline in the number of Nvidia shares it held between September 2025 and March 2026 — from 3.5 million shares worth $652 million to 1.78 million worth $310 million, per CNBC&\#x27;s analysis of securities filings — as the firm, formerly run by Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and now led by his sons, faces questions over Lutnick&\#x27;s handling of suspected Nvidia chip smuggling to China. Cantor said its Nvidia positions were "immaterial" and tied to client swap transactions, and CNBC reported there is no evidence the holdings changes were linked to intelligence warnings or that Lutnick shared nonpublic information.
